bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 14 × 14 × 6 inches are permitted and searched; larger bags and backpacks are refused. Paid lockers on the ground level are available first come, first served.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.summary: The Rooftop says multiple off-site parking lots are available nearby and directs drivers to its Getting Here page; it does not offer a universal concert parking price.
parking.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

rideshare.summary: The venue has not published a specific rideshare pickup or drop-off point in its A-Z guide.
rideshare.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

concessions.summary: Concessions are sold at all ticketed rooftop concerts. Outside food and drinks are prohibited; one empty non-glass reusable water bottle up to 18 oz is allowed, subject to artist changes.
allowed: One empty non-glass reusable water bottle up to 18 oz
concessions.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

accessibility.summary: Guests needing accommodation may use ground-level elevators across from the AXS Box Office. Accessible restrooms are on the fourth floor; general-admission ticket holders can visit the box office on show day for accessible seating assistance.
accessibility.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

reEntry.summary: The Rooftop prohibits re-entry during events except at management’s discretion.
reEntry.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

ticketPickup.summary: The AXS Box Office and will call are on the ground level of Pier 17 on its west side near the Tin Building. Published seasonal hours are Monday through Saturday, noon to 6 p.m., plus show days.
ticketPickup.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

gates.summary: The A-Z guide identifies the elevator entrance near the AXS Box Office for accessible entry but does not state a universal concert door-opening time.
gates.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.
